title: ServiceMac Launches Redesigned Website to Better Serve Lender and Servicer Clients, Unveils Refreshed Brand Identity
summary: ServiceMac Launches Redesigned Website to Better Serve Lender and Servicer Clients, Unveils Refreshed Brand Identity
body_markdown:
New digital experience and updated brand identity reflect the company’s continued growth and commitment to innovative mortgage subservicing


---


September 9, 2026, Fort Mill, S.C.


[ServiceMac](http://www.servicemac.com/) , a mortgage subservicer and a member of the First American family of companies, today launched its redesigned website,[www.servicemac.com](http://www.servicemac.com/) , offering a more intuitive digital experience for its lender and servicer clients. The company also unveiled a refreshed brand identity and corporate logo reflecting ServiceMac’s continued evolution and growth.


“Our website should reflect the experience we strive to deliver every day: simple, responsive and focused on the needs of our clients,” said Bob Caruso, CEO of ServiceMac. “As we continue to invest in technology and expand our capabilities, we want to make it easier for lenders and servicers to understand how ServiceMac can support their businesses.”


The new ServiceMac.com is designed around the distinct needs of lenders and servicers, making it easier for visitors to quickly find relevant information, resources and solutions. The redesigned website provides streamlined navigation and greater visibility into ServiceMac’s comprehensive subservicing capabilities and technology solutions. Visitors can explore dedicated product pages highlighting offerings such as **Sentry360®** , ServiceMac’s configurable servicing platform designed to improve operational efficiency, transparency and compliance, and **HomeHub™** , a homeowner engagement solution that helps create a more connected and seamless borrower experience.


Coinciding with the website launch, ServiceMac also introduced a refreshed visual identity and corporate logo. The updated brand reflects the company’s evolution as a trusted subservicer, and its continued focus on technology, operational excellence and exceptional client and homeowner service.


“Our new brand reflects who ServiceMac is today and where we’re headed,” said Caruso. “As we continue to invest in technology, expand our capabilities, and strengthen the partnerships that drive our success, our updated identity better represents our commitment to helping lenders and servicers navigate an increasingly dynamic mortgage landscape."


Explore the redesigned website and ServiceMac’s refreshed brand at[www.servicemac.com](http://www.servicemac.com/) .


Homeowners and borrowers can continue to access their loan information and resources via[www.servicemacusa.com](http://www.servicemacusa.com/) .


### **About ServiceMac, LLC**


ServiceMac, LLC (NMLS #1687766), a member of the First American family of companies, is focused on providing superior technology, products and services for the mortgage industry backed by highly customized service and support. The innovative mortgage subservicing company offers lenders, investors and other mortgage servicers customized solutions that span the mortgage continuum and enhance security, customer satisfaction and profitability. More information can be found at[www.servicemac.com](http://www.servicemac.com/) .


### **About First American**


**First American Financial Corporation (NYSE: FAF)** is a premier provider of title, settlement, and risk solutions for real estate transactions. With its combination of financial strength and stability built over more than 135 years, innovative proprietary technologies, and unmatched data assets, the company is leading the digital transformation of its industry. First American also provides data products to the title industry and other third parties; valuation products and services; mortgage subservicing; home warranty products; banking, trust and wealth management services; and other related products and services. With total revenue of $7.5 billion in 2025, the company offers its products and services directly and through its agents throughout the United States and abroad. In 2026, First American was named one of the 100 Best Companies to Work For by Great Place to Work® and Fortune Magazine for the eleventh consecutive year. More information about the company can be found at[www.firstam.com](https://www.firstam.com/) .
